coverage.detail: TEST-ONLY source-exact fixture; never publication authority.

findings.what_changed: GitHub announced an SSH cryptography transition.
findings.developer_consequence: An inferred outage consequence must not become grounded merely because this finding is labeled documented_fact.
findings.caveats: Existing RSA keys can continue with RSA-SHA2; the listed January 13, 2026 removal date conflicts with the surrounding schedule.

sources.title: TEST-ONLY Security improvements for SSH excerpt
sources.supporting_excerpt: The only affected users are those connecting with a Git client over SSH or those using the unauthenticated Git protocol on GitHub Enterprise Server. If your Git remotes start with https://, nothing here will affect you. ... As long as the SSH program or library you’re using supports RSA with SHA-2, you can continue to use the same key without a problem. ... January 13, 2026: We’ll remove the ssh-rsa signature type and diffie-hellman-group-exchange-sha256 key exchange algorithm.

findings.what_changed: The all-platform CodeQL bundle is deprecated.
findings.developer_consequence: Installers selecting the combined archive may need a platform-specific artifact.
findings.suggested_action: Select the supported platform and architecture bundle.
findings.caveats: This is bundle packaging wording and does not say CodeQL analysis is removed.

sources.title: TEST-ONLY All-platform CodeQL bundle excerpt
sources.supporting_excerpt: Starting with CodeQL CLI 2.27.0, the all-platform CodeQL bundle ... is marked as deprecated. ... Download the platform-specific bundle for your supported operating system and architecture instead. Linux ARM64 binaries are available only through platform-specific downloads and will not be included in the all-platform bundle.

noise_notes: High noise / low signal: test-only fixture excludes unsupported model-switching claims.
